x: This time was three seconds faster than Wooderson's schoolboy record, and compares favourably with the schoolboy times of American stars, such as Cunningham's 4m. 24.7s., MacMitchell's 4m. 21.1s., Dodds' 4m. 28.4s., Lash's 4m. 30.5s., and Zamperini's 4m. 21.2s.

After a terrific struggle Vern. was barely a yard ahead of Reid at the change over, with Wooderson some distance in the rear. On to the foot of Dale Hill, about 4¾ miles, Len Herbert was never comfortable and eventually finished 35 secs. behind the Stagbearers.
A good turn out and a good crowd - mainly to see Wooderson. A good race with Carter in his unbeatable mood; and a 30-points margin in our team win.

His interest had been sparked by the "Kings of Speed" cigarette card series which featured Wooderson, Whitlock, Owens, etc.; and when he heard that Wooderson was to run at Tooting Bec in a ¾ mile record attempt he cycled there especially to witness one of his heroes.
